_about: Codewhale's corrections to Models.dev rows (#6396). Applied to the bundled seed and to live Models.dev rows alike, above both and below signed cloud facts and provider rosters, so a correction holds on every install, online or offline. Corrections only fix rows that exist: they never add or hide one. Each entry says why; a correction whose value now equals upstream is stale and should be deleted. See docs/CATALOG_REFRESH.md.
